cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
cards.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our meeting chairs float at noon. Book the ceiling; they've had landing rights since the first furniture strike.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we stand and tie the chairs down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can stand. Tying broke the last treaty; that's when the desks joined them. I'll get an airspace permit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The caretaker only issues floor permits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll appoint her altitude minister too. Get her signature before the cabinets claim the roof.
